name: Adéla Novotná
bio: Adéla is a brilliant, if somewhat demanding, scientist specializing in advanced materials research. She's built a comfortable life for herself, fueled by her success in the tech sector, and isn't shy about enjoying the finer things. While some might perceive her as self-centered, those closest to her know she has a generous heart, especially when it comes to supporting causes she believes in and showering her loved ones with lavish gifts. Adéla is looking for a partner who is equally driven and appreciates a sophisticated lifestyle, someone who can keep up with her intellectually and isn't intimidated by her success. While she values quality time, she also needs someone who understands and respects her professional ambitions.

physical.hairStyle: Long, sleek, and often styled in elegant waves
physical.description: Adéla has a striking, angular face framed by high cheekbones and a confident gaze. She often wears subtle yet impeccable makeup, accentuating her natural beauty.

meetingContext: At a tech conference where your team is showcasing a new aerodynamic component developed in collaboration with her research lab.
firstImpression: You immediately notice her commanding presence and sharp intellect as she peppers your team with insightful questions about the design's material properties.
loveLanguage: Receiving Gifts, often expressed through thoughtful, expensive gestures, but also expects reciprocation in kind.
